name: Emperor's Chosen

traits.name: Exemplar
traits.text: You increase your Influence, Resolve, and Conviction each by +1.

note: Not a Shield Host as such: the host for Custodians who belong to none (p.42).

traits.name: Warden
traits.text: When an enemy engaged with you attempts to Fall Back, roll a number of d6 equal to Double Rank. For each Icon rolled, the enemy’s Speed is reduced by 1.

traits.name: Wrath of the Throne
traits.text: At the start of the first round of combat, or when you enter combat, enemies who can see you who lack the IMPERIUM keyword must pass a DN 2 +Rank Fear test.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.text: At the start of the first round of combat, or when you enter combat, you may select a single ally with the IMPERIUM keyword. While that ally is within 3 metres of you, they add +Rank to their Defence.

traits.name: Swift Onslaught
traits.text: When you Run, Sprint, or Charge, you increase your Speed by +1. Further, you may Fall Back as a Simple Action rather than a Combat Action.

traits.name: Herald of the Throne
traits.text: Allies within 9m who possess the IMPERIUM keyword increase their Resolve and Conviction by +Rank.

name: The Dark

traits.name: Dark Deeds
traits.text: When the character makes a melee attack, improve the AP of that attack by 1.

note: A Saedath, which replaces [SAEDATH]; SubFactionType has no saedath, so masque is the closest fit.

name: The Light

traits.name: Blaze of Light
traits.text: When the character is the target of a ranged attack and their attacker is 12 of more metres away, add +1 to the character’s Defence.

note: A Saedath, which replaces [SAEDATH]; SubFactionType has no saedath, so masque is the closest fit. "12 of more metres" as printed (for "12 or more").

name: The Twilight

traits.name: Twilight Falls
traits.text: When the character uses the Charge action, they gain +1 bonus dice when making their attack.

note: A Saedath, which replaces [SAEDATH]; SubFactionType has no saedath, so masque is the closest fit.

name: Nomadic Houses

traits.name: Nomadic
traits.text: Nomadic Houses are well-travelled. They grant +Rank dice to Pilot tests and Conviction.

note: A House type, not a named House: the [HOUSE] keyword is replaced with the character's own House name, which the book leaves to the player (p.53). The keyword here is a stand-in. Trait name is editorial: the book prints each House type as an unnamed bullet.

name: Magisterial Houses

traits.name: Magisterial
traits.text: Magisterial Houses are exalted and influential. They add +Rank to their Influence and Wealth.

note: A House type, not a named House: the [HOUSE] keyword is replaced with the character's own House name, which the book leaves to the player (p.53). The keyword here is a stand-in. Trait name is editorial: the book prints each House type as an unnamed bullet.

name: Shrouded Houses

traits.name: Shrouded
traits.text: Shrouded Houses are mysterious and opportunistic. They add +Rank to Cunning and Stealth tests.

note: A House type, not a named House: the [HOUSE] keyword is replaced with the character's own House name, which the book leaves to the player (p.53). The keyword here is a stand-in. Trait name is editorial: the book prints each House type as an unnamed bullet.

name: Renegade Houses

traits.name: Renegade
traits.text: Renegade Houses are forsaken and corrupt. They begin with 1d3x Tier Corruption but add +Rank to Psychic Mastery tests and Maximum Shock.

note: A House type, not a named House: the [HOUSE] keyword is replaced with the character's own House name, which the book leaves to the player (p.53). The keyword here is a stand-in. Trait name is editorial: the book prints each House type as an unnamed bullet.

name: The Greater Thurian League

traits.name: Highly Efficient
traits.text: You add +1 to your Influence, and you gain +1 Wealth at the end of each session.

note: Keyword drops the leading "The" (the book prints no keyword form).

name: The Ymyr Conglomerate

traits.name: Elite Artisans
traits.text: You add +Rank to Tech skill tests and add +1 to the AR of any armour you wear.

note: Keyword drops the leading "The" (the book prints no keyword form).

traits.name: To the Last
traits.text: You add +Rank to your Resolve, and you add +1 to your Determination.

traits.name: Nomadic Explorers
traits.text: You increase your Passive Awareness by +Rank and add +1d to all Pilot skill tests.

traits.name: Aggressive Expansion
traits.text: You may re-roll Rank dice on melee attacks when you charge and add +1ED to the damage of all melee attacks when you charge.

name: The Ghulo Industrial Complex
note: Other Leagues (p.65): "there are no listed benefits for characters from those Leagues, but they may spark the imagination, and a suitable bonus can be discussed with your Gamemaster." Keyword drops the leading "The" (the book prints no keyword form).

note: Other Leagues (p.65): "there are no listed benefits for characters from those Leagues, but they may spark the imagination, and a suitable bonus can be discussed with your Gamemaster." Keyword drops the leading "The" (the book prints no keyword form).

name: Bork'an Sept

traits.name: Air Caste
traits.text: Air caste T’au from Bork’an add +1 to the Speed, Wounds, and Resilience of their vehicles, due to superior engineering.

traits.name: Earth Caste
traits.text: Earth caste T’au from Bork’an add +2 to their Medicae, Scholar, and Tech skills.

traits.name: Fire Caste
traits.text: Fire caste T’au from Bork’an add +2 to the short range of their ranged weapons, +4 to the medium range, and +6 to the long range.

traits.name: Water Caste
traits.text: Water caste T’au from Bork’an are practical and reliable; they may re-roll a 1 on their Wrath die when attempting a Cunning, Deception, Insight, or Persuasion test.

note: Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All".

name: Dal'yth Sept

traits.name: Air Caste
traits.text: Air caste T’au from Dal’yth add +2 to the Defence of their vehicles when they perform Evasive Action.

traits.name: Earth Caste
traits.text: Earth caste T’au from Dal’yth carry devices which are cunningly wrought with hidden functions or secret countermeasures: double the range of the character’s Tech interaction attacks.

traits.name: Fire Caste
traits.text: Fire caste T’au from Dal’yth employ advanced camouflage systems to obscure their presence; if they do not move during their turn, they add +2 to their Defence (as if in cover) until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Water Caste
traits.text: Water caste T’au from Dal’yth add +2 to their Cunning, Deception, Insight, and Persuasion skills.

note: Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All".

name: The Farsight Enclaves

traits.name: All T'au
traits.text: All T’au from the Farsight Enclaves are rebels, free from the dogma and deceptions of the Ethereals, and add +2 to their Conviction.

traits.name: Fire Caste
traits.text: Fire caste T’au from the Farsight Enclaves are drilled to engage enemies at close range: they add an extra +2 to all attacks made against enemies within 9m.

note: Keyword drops the leading "The" (the book prints no keyword form). Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All".

name: Sa'cea Sept

traits.name: All T'au
traits.text: All T’au from Sa’cea add +1 to their Resolve.

traits.name: Air Caste
traits.text: Air caste T’au from Sa’cea hone their skills in the skies above dense cityscapes, where absolute precision is needed: they may re-roll any 1s rolled (even on a Wrath die) for Pilot tests.

traits.name: Earth Caste
traits.text: Earth caste T’au from Sa’cea are keenly observant, almost to a point of wariness, and add +2d to all Awareness tests.

traits.name: Fire Caste
traits.text: Fire caste T’au from Sa’cea have exceptional fire discipline: they may re-roll one die on any Ballistic Skill test they attempt.

note: Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All".

name: T'au Sept

traits.name: All T'au
traits.text: All T’au from the T’au Sept grant +1 additional die when they assist an ally. Further, whenever they use an ability which affects T’AU EMPIRE allies, the range is increased by +3m.

note: Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All".

name: Vior'la Sept

traits.name: Air Caste
traits.text: Air caste T’au from Vior’la have a knack for high-speed manoeuvres that other T’au might balk at: they ignore the additional Wrath Dice that comes piloting a vehicle at Breakneck speed.

traits.name: Earth Caste
traits.text: Earth caste T’au from Vior’la are quick to experiment and jury-rig the devices they use: they may add a second Wrath die to any Tech test they attempt, and thus have the potential for two criticals, two complications, or one of each.

traits.name: Fire Caste
traits.text: Fire caste T’au advance and redeploy quickly, adding +1 to their Speed during the first round of each combat, and +1 Speed when they Run or Sprint.

traits.name: Water Caste
traits.text: Water caste T’au from Vior’la are fast-talking and effusive: they may add a second Wrath die to any Persuasion test they attempt, and thus have the potential for two criticals, two complications, or one of each.

note: The Fire caste bullet omits "from Vior’la", as printed. Trait names are editorial: the book prints bullets led by the bold caste name, or "All". Air caste "the additional Wrath Dice that comes piloting" as printed.

name: Black Templars
note: SUCCESSOR: Imperial Fists. Restriction as printed: "Characters with the BLACK TEMPLARS keyword may not, under any circumstances, take the PSYKER keyword: The Black Templars accept no psykers within their ranks."

traits.name: Righteous Zeal
traits.text:
Your hatred permits you to show no mercy, nor does it permit you to yield while the enemy draws breath.

When you charge, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on your Weapon Skill test. In addition, you may re-roll Rank dice when you roll Determination.

traits.name: Gene-Seed Flaw (Gene-Seed)
traits.text:
Though proven resistant to mutation and deviance, Rogal Dorn’s gene-seed inhibits two of the Space Marine implants.

You are missing implant 12: Sus-an Membrane, and implant 17: Betcher’s Gland.

name: Crimson Fists
note: SUCCESSOR: Imperial Fists.

traits.name: No Matter the Odds
traits.text:
You will not yield in the face of overwhelming odds.

When making an attack while you and your allies are outnumbered at least two-to-one, you may add Rank dice to your Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill test.

traits.name: Gene-Seed Flaw (Gene-Seed)
traits.text:
Though proven resistant to mutation and deviance, Rogal Dorn’s gene-seed inhibits two of the Space Marine implants.

You are missing implant 12: Sus-an Membrane, and implant 17: Betcher’s Gland.

name: Flesh Tearers
note: SUCCESSOR: Blood Angels.

traits.name: Fury Within
traits.text:
You are possessed of a bloodthirsty recklessness. When properly directed, this murderous ferocity makes you unstoppable.

You may re-roll Double Rank dice once per melee attack Test. In addition, if you shift one or more Icons on a melee attack, improve the AP of your attack by 1 (i.e., from -1 to -2).

traits.name: The Red Thirst (Gene-seed)
traits.text:
Your fury comes from a deep destructive impulse within your body and soul, an insatiable bloodlust that resists all attempts to deny it.

Whenever you are in melee combat and see blood, you must make a DN 4 Willpower Test. If you fail, you are Frenzied.

name: Grey Knights
note: Restriction as printed: "Due to their unique geneseed and secretive nature, the Grey Knights do not yet count any Primaris Marines amongst their number. As such, Primaris Astartes characters cannot select this CHAPTER." The lore also says "Every Grey Knight is a psyker".

traits.name: Daemonbane
traits.text:
You have been taught the secrets of daemon-kind to best understand how to end them.

When attacking a creature with the DAEMON keyword in melee combat, you add +Rank ED to the attack’s damage. You also add +Rank to your Conviction.

traits.name: Secretive (Tradition)
traits.text:
Grey Knights do not trust outsiders, and their nature cannot be permitted to be known to any outside the chapter.

You suffer a +2DN penalty for Interaction tests involving anyone who lacks the Grey Knights or Inquisition keywords.

name: Emperor's Children
note: Legion: III. Primarch: Fulgrim. Restriction as printed: "Characters with the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN keyword must take SLAANESH as their [MARK OF CHAOS] keyword."

traits.name: In Pursuit of Perfection
traits.text:
Each Emperor’s Children Space Marine seeks to perfect a single aspect of the arts of warfare.

Select one of the following skills: Awareness, Ballistic Skill, Leadership, Pilot, Weapon Skill. You gain +Rank dice as a bonus to all uses of that skill.

traits.name: Fear of Imperfection (Tradition)
traits.text:
The Emperor’s Children cannot abide the imperfect and fear the notion that a flaw may mean perfection is unattainable.

Whenever you suffer a complication on the skill chosen for Pursuit of Perfection, above, the GM gains 1 Ruin, in addition to any other results.

name: Iron Warriors
note: Legion: IV. Primarch: Perturabo.

traits.name: Siege Masters
traits.text:
Iron Warriors know fortifications.

You may reroll Double Rank dice whenever you attack a building, fortification, or an enemy in cover.

You may also add +Rank dice whenever you make a test related to architectural engineering.

traits.name: Scorn for the Weak (Tradition)
traits.text:
Iron Warriors despise weakness in their comrades.

If one of your allies fails a Resolve test, you must pass a Willpower test (DN 3). On a failure, you feel a strong urge to punish that ally. If the failure involves a complication, the urge becomes a compulsion. The GM may alter the DN based on the severity or significance of the failure.

name: Night Lords
note: Legion: VIII. Primarch: Konrad Curze.

traits.name: Ave Dominus Nox
traits.text:
Night Lords revel in the fear of others and are swift to spread it.

While under cover of darkness, you may add +Rank to your Defence and Speed.

As a free action at the start of combat, you may spend one Glory to cause Fear for the duration of the fight; enemies who see you must pass a Fear test (DN 2 + Double Rank).

traits.name: Blood of Nostramo (Tradition)
traits.text:
Night Lords often recruit from amongst the criminal element and have little love for a fair fight.

If you see an ally fail a Resolve or Fear test, you must attempt a Resolve test (DN 3) or become pinned.

name: World Eaters
note: Legion: XII. Primarch: Angron. Restriction as printed: "Characters with the WORLD EATERS keyword must take KHORNE as their [MARK OF CHAOS] keyword."

traits.name: Incarnate Violence
traits.text:
You are driven to spill blood and rend flesh, and nothing will stop you.

You may reroll Double Rank dice on any melee attack test.

traits.name: Butcher's Nails (Gene-Seed)
traits.text:
The implants buried in your skull drive you into fits of berserk rage in battle.

Upon engaging in melee combat, you become Frenzied for the rest of the battle. The Willpower test to restrain your frenzy increases by +1 for every enemy you have killed during the battle.

name: Death Guard
note: Legion: XIV. Primarch: Mortarion. Restriction as printed: "Characters with the DEATH GUARD keyword must take NURGLE as their [MARK OF CHAOS] keyword." No Gene-Seed trait is printed.

traits.name: Inexorable Advance
traits.text:
The brutal, relentless stride of the Death Guard is accompanied by a constant barrage of fire.

You suffer no penalty for operating a Heavy weapon without bracing it, and when you take a normal move, you may use your Simple Action to aim.

traits.name: Intractable (Tradition)
traits.text:
Death Guard are slow and purposeful, never given to needless haste when they could instead grind their foes down with inexorable force.

You must spend a point of Glory to take the Sprint action.

name: Thousand Sons
note: Legion: XV. Primarch: Magnus the Red. "These rules reflect those who possess psychic abilities, rather than the Rubricae automata that accompany them into battle." Restriction as printed: "Characters with the THOUSAND SONS keyword must take TZEENTCH as their [MARK OF CHAOS] keyword."

traits.name: The Rubric
traits.text:
A Thousand Sons are legendary for their mastery of warp-craft.

You gain the Favoured by The Warp talent.

traits.name: Gift of Mutation (Gene-Seed)
traits.text:
Between your unstable gene-seed and the attentions of the Changer of Ways, the Thousand Sons are especially prone to mutation.

You gain an additional +1 Corruption whenever you would gain one or more Corruption points. You also increase the DN of all tests to resist Corruption or Malignancy by +1.

name: Black Legion
note: Legion: XVI. Primarch: Horus Lupercal. No Gene-Seed trait is printed.

traits.name: The Tip of the Spear
traits.text:
The Black Legion epitomise the Traitor Legions’ threat, swift, ruthless, and unyielding in their hateful fervour.

You may re-roll Rank dice on all Ballistic Skill tests made with a ranged weapon at close range. You may also re-roll Rank dice on Weapon Skill tests made when you Charge.

You also gain +1 Resolve.

traits.name: Bitter Pride (Tradition)
traits.text:
The Black Legion have little love for those outside their ranks.

You suffer a +2DN penalty for Interaction tests involving anyone outside the Black Legion, unless those people are subordinate to the Black Legion character.

name: Word Bearers
note: Legion: XVII. Primarch: Lorgar Aurelian. No Gene-Seed trait is printed.

traits.name: Profane Zeal
traits.text:
The Word Bearers march to war for the glory of the Dark Gods.

When you charge, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on your Weapon Skill test. In addition, you may re-roll Rank dice when you roll Determination.

In addition, you are immune to fear caused by creatures with the DAEMON keyword.

traits.name: The Will of the Gods (Tradition)
traits.text:
Word Bearers follow the will of the Chaos Gods, as interpreted through their prayers and visions, and through the guidance of their Apostles, and must strive to walk the path the Dark Gods set before them.

You start each session with 1 Wrath Point instead of 2.

name: Alpha Legion
note: Legion: XX. Primarch: Alpharius Omegon. No Gene-Seed trait is printed.

traits.name: Mutable Tactics
traits.text:
The Alpha Legion are masters of misdirection and sabotage, undermining their foes long before battle is joined.

After each Respite, select one of the following skills: Athletics, Cunning, Deception, Intimidation, Persuasion, Stealth, or Tech. You may re-roll up to Rank dice on any test involving the chosen skill.

traits.name: I Am Alpharius (Tradition)
traits.text:
The Alpha Legion rely on deception and misdirection, and disdain direct tactics.

Add 1 to Ruin when you fail an Intellect test, as your carefully wrought plans and contingencies fail you.

name: Order of the Argent Shroud
note: Orders Militant.

traits.name: Deeds, Not Words
traits.text: When you make an attack, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on that attack.

name: Order of the Bloody Rose
note: Orders Militant.

traits.name: Quick to Anger
traits.text: Add +Rank bonus dice to your melee attacks when you Charge.

name: Order of the Ebon Chalice
note: Orders Militant.

traits.name: Daughter of the Emperor
traits.text: When you roll Determination, you may spend 1 Faith. If you do so, negate all damage the attack would cause, including Mortal Wounds, but do not suffer any Shock.

name: Order of the Sacred Rose
note: Orders Militant.

traits.name: Devout Serenity
traits.text: You increase your Resolve by +Rank. Further, if you ever roll a 6 on your Wrath die when making a Resolve test, you gain 1 Faith.

name: Order of the Valorous Heart
note: Orders Militant.

traits.name: Stoic Endurance
traits.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to Determination rolls.

name: Order of the Holy Word
note: Orders Dialogus: "These [ORDER] options may by selected by any Sister Dialogus (found in the Forsaken System Player's Guide) or Sister Dialogus Polyglot (p. 90) characters." ("may by" as printed.) Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Voice of the Church
traits.text: You gain +Rank bonus dice on all Persuasion tests.

name: Order of the Quill
note: Orders Dialogus: "These [ORDER] options may by selected by any Sister Dialogus (found in the Forsaken System Player's Guide) or Sister Dialogus Polyglot (p. 90) characters." ("may by" as printed.) Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Pious Scrutiny
traits.text: Your Passive Awareness is increased by +Rank.

name: Order of the Sacred Oath
note: Orders Dialogus: "These [ORDER] options may by selected by any Sister Dialogus (found in the Forsaken System Player's Guide) or Sister Dialogus Polyglot (p. 90) characters." ("may by" as printed.) Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Voice of Judgement
traits.text: When you attempt a Persuasion interaction attack, you may spend 1 Faith Point to target +Rank enemies.

name: Order of the Lexicon
note: Orders Dialogus: "These [ORDER] options may by selected by any Sister Dialogus (found in the Forsaken System Player's Guide) or Sister Dialogus Polyglot (p. 90) characters." ("may by" as printed.) Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Unquestioned Faith
traits.text: You increase your Conviction by +Rank.

name: Order of the Key
note: Orders Famulous: "These [ORDER] options may be selected by Sister Famulous (p. 91) characters." Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Key to Power
traits.text: You increase your Influence by +1.

name: Order of the Gate
note: Orders Famulous: "These [ORDER] options may be selected by Sister Famulous (p. 91) characters." Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Watchful Counselor
traits.text: When you attempt an Awareness, Insight, Leadership, Scholar, or Persuasion test, each point of Glory you spend adds +2 dice.

name: Order of the Holy Seal
note: Orders Famulous: "These [ORDER] options may be selected by Sister Famulous (p. 91) characters." Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Inescapable Scrutiny
traits.text: When you succeed at an Insight test, you may spend 1 Faith point to discern some inner truth or secret shame of the target. Ask the GM one question about the target.

name: Order of the Sacred Coin
note: Orders Famulous: "These [ORDER] options may be selected by Sister Famulous (p. 91) characters." Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Faith and Coin
traits.text: When you attempt an Influence test to requisition items, you may spend 2 Glory to gain the effects of 1 Wealth.

name: Order of the Eternal Candle
note: Orders Hospitaller (no archetype restriction printed). Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Healing Light
traits.text: When you succeed at a Medicae test to heal wounds or stabilise a dying character, or when you heal Wounds during a Regroup, you may spend 1 Faith to heal an additional +Double Rank Wounds.

name: Order of Serenity
note: Orders Hospitaller (no archetype restriction printed). Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Serene Endurance
traits.text: When you succeed at a Medicae test to recover a patient’s Shock, recover +Rank shock. Your own Maximum Shock is increased by +Rank.

name: Order of the Cleansing Water
note: Orders Hospitaller (no archetype restriction printed). Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Indomitable Purity
traits.text: Allies with the IMPERIUM keyword within 6m of you reduce the rating of any Poisoned condition, or the DN of any test to resist disease, by 1+ double your Rank. If this would reduce the rating or DN to 0, then the poison or disease has no effect.

name: Order of the Torch
note: Orders Hospitaller (no archetype restriction printed). Non-Militant Order lore and abilities are entirely homebrew (p.34).

traits.name: Purifying Flame
traits.text: When you attempt a Medicae test to remove a condition, you gain +Rank bonus dice on the test.

traits.name: Staunch Defenders
traits.text: When you are in cover and did not move during your turn, you add +Rank bonus dice to your ranged attacks.

traits.name: Refusal to Yield
traits.text: When you make a Test while Dying, you heal 1 Wound for each Wrath Critical you roll. When you make a Test while under the effects of Fear, Terror or Pinning, a Wrath Critical causes you to recover from that condition immediately. However, you must spend a point of Glory to Fall Back.

traits.name: The Solar Blessing
traits.text: When attacked by a weapon with only 1 ED, gain +1 Resilience.

traits.name: Red in Cog and Claw
traits.text: You may re-roll up to Rank dice when making a melee attack.

traits.name: Shroud Protocols
traits.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to Stealth Tests and gain an additional +1 to Defence against ranged attacks from more than 12 metres away.

traits.name: Grim Survivors
traits.text: Your Determination is increased by +Rank.
